run_fetch_dataset: run the fetch_dataset script to download files from a manifold dataset to a target path
run_fetch_file: run the fetch_file function to download a single file from the manifold dataset to a destination
run_create_dir: run the create_dir function to create a directory at the specified destination path
run_run_cmd: run the run_cmd function to execute a shell command with optional dry-run mode
run_fetch_dataset_cli: run the CLI with --dst-path and --file-list args to fetch a dataset from a JSON manifest
